messages:
Jin (sec-eng): Planning note: we need a focused retest dry-run for the RBAC tweaks + KMS proxy changes. Goal: produce an audit bundle that satisfies compliance QA and the external assessor.
Riley (infra): Agree. Which artifacts does compliance need exactly?
Nina (compliance): Minimal required: CloudTrail events for AssumeRole and Encrypt/Decrypt, KMS CloudWatch logs, SIEM events for auth failures, and an S3 evidence bundle with checksums. Also a manifest.json describing filters used.
Tara (platform): We'll tag the ephemeral sessions with 'penrun-<ticket>-<ts>' so everything is filterable. Also will annotate the Terraform change with a gate flag.
Omar (oncall): Proposed window: Fri 05:00-08:00 UTC (low traffic). I'll staff the bridge. If error budget increases by >4% or 5xx spikes, we rollback.
Jin (sec-eng): Rollback plan: disable feature flag -> revoke assumed-session tokens via STS revoke list -> restore KMS alias to alias/staging-prev (we keep snapshots). Steps in runbook with exact ARNs.
Riley (infra): Example CloudWatch Logs Insights query for KMS usage:
```
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter message like /Decrypt|Encrypt/ and message like /alias\/redwood-staging-kms/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 200
```
Riley (infra): CloudTrail example to find AssumeRole for our tag:
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=AssumeRole --start-time 2026-04-15T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-04-15T03:00:00Z --query 'Events[?contains(CloudTrailEvent, `penrun-`) ]'
```
Tara (platform): Terraform snippet we'll flip (feature flag):
```hcl
variable "enable_rbac_retest" { default = false }
resource "null_resource" "apply_gate" {
  count = var.enable_rbac_retest ? 1 : 0
}
```
Nina (compliance): Evidence packaging requirement: zip (max 2GB) into s3://evidence-prod/retests/4965001234/ with manifest.json and checksums.sha256. Signed PGP of manifest optional but preferred.
Omar (oncall): I'll run 100 synthetic /v1/infer requests over the window and capture per-request status + token latency. If median latency shifts >15% vs baseline or error rate >4% we abort.
Jin (sec-eng): For retest acceptance: assessor needs (A) reproducible AssumeRole events, (B) KMS key usage timeline with requestor sessionName, (C) S3 evidence bundle with checksums, (D) SIEM correlation showing no privilege escalation.
Riley (infra): I'll set temporary trail retention to 180 days for staging and tag all events with run-id. Also enabling detailed request logging on the KMS proxy for the window.
Tara (platform): Post-run steps: (1) export CloudTrail slice -> gzipped JSON, (2) snapshot KMS key usage logs, (3) export IAM sessions table from our auth DB, (4) create the evidence bundle.
Jin (sec-eng): Also include a short explainer.txt documenting the test steps and the exact queries used to collect logs so the assessor can validate.
Nina (compliance): I'll verify within 72 hours. If anything missing we'll request a narrow rerun for that artifact only.
scheduler-bot: scheduled-job created by Riley: rbac-kms-dryrun-4965 2026-04-16T05:30:00Z -> 2026-04-16T06:30:00Z (staging). JobID: sj-4965-dryrun
Omar (oncall): Bridge link: https://call.redwood.ai/bridge/4965001234. I'll join 10 mins early.
Jin (sec-eng): Thanks team. I'll publish the final pre-run checklist tomorrow and ping @Nina and @Omar for sign-off. If anyone needs extra telemetry (e.g., packet captures of KMS proxy) call it out now.
Tara (platform): We might capture tcpdump on the proxy container for 10 seconds during the canary — will need sign-off from infra for storage.
Riley (infra): OK — create an issue in infra with retention TTL for pcap and I'll approve.
Nina (compliance): Approving pcap for the short canary as long as it's uploaded to the evidence bucket and rotated/encrypted.
Jin (sec-eng): Great. Ending notes: do not touch production aliases, do not remove CloudTrail events, and keep a clear chain of custody on the S3 objects. We'll attach the JIRA: SEC-9212 for tracking.
